title: lichen_link_set_slot accepts sentinel slot_id==0xff when ctx==NULL
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:102. With auto-derive sentinel 0xff and ctx NULL the function proceeds, storing slot=0xff instead of returning -EINVAL; subsequent tdma_tx_allowed computes nonsense offsets. Carried over verbatim during dedup. Fix: return -EINVAL when slot_id==0xff && ctx==NULL before assignment.
close_reason: lichen_link_set_slot returns -EINVAL when tdma!=NULL && ctx==NULL && slot_id==0xff before any write. Verified in ASan/UBSan harness: (-EINVAL returned, struct untouched synced=false/slot=0); explicit-slot-id with NULL ctx still succeeds (legit path). Grep of tree: no in-tree callers other than declaration; spec-only references — no regression surface. Test assertion added in lichen/tests/link_crypto/src/main.c.
